descriptions.d26c_actor_die_or_spawn_800ed13c: With Desc+456 set read position and velocity at the context time and fire through 0x800ec6a8 with a zero vector. Otherwise when the descriptor type is exactly 0x80368418 create an object from key 0x8040f038, give it the descriptor handle, copy position, rotation and velocity, set its timer +32 to +84 minus the time when +84 is not negative (a negative value is stored as is), attach it to the service with the owner id and finish through 0x8015fd1c.
